HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Path of Action? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Path of Action.
   B. Say Path of Action has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Path of Action with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Path of Action to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Buddhist Principles of Dharma Noble Eightfold Path? (1 mark)
   A. Use Buddhist Principles of Dharma Noble Eightfold Path to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Buddhist Principles of Dharma Noble Eightfold Path with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Buddhist Principles of Dharma Noble Eightfold Path.
   D. Say Buddhist Principles of Dharma Noble Eightfold Path has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Fundamental Principles ,? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Fundamental Principles , with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Fundamental Principles , to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Fundamental Principles ,.
   D. Say Fundamental Principles , has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation.
   B. Say Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

6. Which response best shows understanding of Religious Ceremonies? (1 mark)
   A. Use Religious Ceremonies to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious Ceremonies.
   C. Say Religious Ceremonies has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Religious Ceremonies with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

8. Which response best shows understanding of Buddhist Sanskaars? (1 mark)
   A. Say Buddhist Sanskaars has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Buddhist Sanskaars to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Buddhist Sanskaars with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Buddhist Sanskaars.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Protocols in Jain Dharma Aarti and Mangal Divo,? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Protocols in Jain Dharma Aarti and Mangal Divo,.
   B. Apply the teaching of Protocols in Jain Dharma Aarti and Mangal Divo, with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Protocols in Jain Dharma Aarti and Mangal Divo, has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Protocols in Jain Dharma Aarti and Mangal Divo, to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Scriptural Texts ● Yajur Ved: Sangathan mantra ● Uttradhyan Sutra Chapter 19- 21? (1 mark)
   A. Say Scriptural Texts ● Yajur Ved: Sangathan mantra ● Uttradhyan Sutra Chapter 19- 21 has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Scriptural Texts ● Yajur Ved: Sangathan mantra ● Uttradhyan Sutra Chapter 19- 21 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Scriptural Texts ● Yajur Ved: Sangathan mantra ● Uttradhyan Sutra Chapter 19- 21.
   D. Use Scriptural Texts ● Yajur Ved: Sangathan mantra ● Uttradhyan Sutra Chapter 19- 21 to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

12. Which response best shows understanding of ● Sukhmani Sahib 9-16 Ashtpadi? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing ● Sukhmani Sahib 9-16 Ashtpadi.
   B. Say ● Sukhmani Sahib 9-16 Ashtpadi has no place in daily life.
   C. Use ● Sukhmani Sahib 9-16 Ashtpadi to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of ● Sukhmani Sahib 9-16 Ashtpadi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Protocols in Jain Dharma Aarti and Mangal Divo, and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Path of Action and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Religious Ceremonies and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Buddhist Sanskaars and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Scriptural Texts ● Yajur Ved: Sangathan mantra ● Uttradhyan Sutra Chapter 19- 21 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain ● Sukhmani Sahib 9-16 Ashtpadi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamental Principles , and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
